title: Ledger investigates wallet drains involving CryptoBilis buyers; estimate tops $86 million in losses
reason: Named company confirming an active investigation into wallet drains with estimated losses topping $86 million is a significant security story.

sources.summary: Ledger said it is investigating reports of fund losses from users in Southeast Asia who bought its products from reseller CryptoBilis.

title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
reason: A major public miner moving $81M in BTC to Galaxy while its treasury shrinks from ~54K to ~36K BTC signals a significant strategic pivot to AI, clearly publishable with named parties.

sources.summary: The bitcoin miner’s transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.
